primary.title: TDS on salary: How does your employer calculate it?
primary.summary: From April 1st, 2026, the TDS on salary is governed by a new law, the Income Tax Act 2025. It replaces the Income Tax Act 1961, which had run for over 60 years. The tax rates and slabs are unchanged, but the forms, the section numbers, and the working behind your monthly deduction have all […] The post TDS on salary: How does your employer calculate it? appeared first on Blogs .
